name: Devils Tower
summary: America's first national monument — a colossal, fluted stone tower rising from the plains, sacred to Native nations and famous from 'Close Encounters.'

item.title: Devils Tower
item.blurb: Walk the 1.3-mile Tower Trail around the base of the 867-ft monolith, watching climbers inch up its columns (a sacred site to many Plains tribes).

item.title: Close Encounters at the visitor center
item.blurb: Spielberg put the mothership behind this rock in 1977 and turned a remote Wyoming monolith into one of the most recognisable shapes on earth; visits jumped and never came back down. The visitor center keeps a display about it. Worth holding both ideas at once — it's a film set to most of the world and a sacred site to more than twenty Plains tribes, who call it Bear Lodge.

rest.label: Under the dark sky
rest.note: There is almost no light out here. Stay after the prairie dogs have gone to bed, lie back on the hood, and look up: the tower goes to silhouette and the Milky Way runs directly over the top of it.

commute.scenicNote: South across the Wyoming plains to Cheyenne.
